title: Adaptive token scales and button edge-case guidelines for docs site
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Purpose: Update the component documentation site with a focused set of practical guidance for the next wave of token and component changes. This ticket covers: adaptive token variants (scale- and density-aware tokens), detailed do/don't examples for button surface and interaction edge cases, responsive/table collapse patterns for data-dense views, and chart labeling/accessibility guidance. We will also include a migration appendix that maps legacy token names to new semantic tokens and provide a lightweight runtime shim pattern that engineers can adopt.
acceptance_criteria: A concise 'Token scales' guide appears on the docs site with examples showing three density profiles (compact, default, spacious), visual diffs, and recommended token usage for form components and table rows.

Button docs include five edge-case examples (icon-only hover, focus ring overlap with badges, loading->success state transition, stacked toolbars, high-density touch targets) with do/don't visuals and minimal code snippets.
Responsive tables doc demonstrates the recommended collapse pattern, examples for column prioritization, ARIA practices for row/column headers, and a small JS snippet for progressive enhancement.

Charts section includes guidance for multi-series labeling, color-blind friendly palettes, reduced-token variants for tiny sparklines, and an accessibility checklist (aria-labels, data-table fallbacks).
Migration appendix lists a mapping table from old tokens to new semantic tokens and includes the proposed CSS/JS shim snippet and a short rollout plan for apps to adopt tokens safely.
Docs page passes design/engineering review and a small usability check with two internal integrators (frontend eng + platform UX).
updates: 2026-02-28 — Kickoff: scoped initial content. Agreed to focus on pragmatic examples rather than exhaustive token reference.
2026-03-03 — Draft complete for tokens and buttons. Sent to ENG for review (ENG-91023). Feedback: clarify token fallback behavior and provide example using runtime shim.
2026-03-06 — Incorporated ENG feedback: added shim snippet and an extra example showing token fallbacks when legacy tokens are present. Updated migration notes with mapping for 12 high-usage tokens.
2026-03-08 — Design review with PM and accessibility lead. A11y asks: add keyboard focus flows for table collapse and ensure chart alternatives. Added ARIA checklist and fallback table example.

2026-03-10 — Preparing PR: documentation pages drafted in /docs/components/token-scales and /docs/components/button-edgecases. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/294. Filing small follow-ups to cover interactive code sandboxes (separate ticket).
notes: Decision: prefer semantic tokens (surface.primary-bg, surface.secondary-bg, ui.padding-compact) over numeric scale names to reduce cognitive overhead for product teams.
Trade-off: providing three density profiles increases examples to maintain but gives clear guidance for customers migrating from ad-hoc CSS scale rules.
Follow-up: open a separate design ticket to build interactive sandboxes demonstrating token toggles (compact/default/spacious) — estimated 2 points.
Engineering ask: ENG team to expose a small runtime helper for token shim (ENG-91023). We included a recommended pattern in the migration appendix.
Reviewer feedback to address in PR: add one more icon-only button example showing screen-reader label patterns and touch target rationale.
